summary: Keep offline script checks independent of host Git configuration and filesystem compression

replay.detail: No claim, projection or replay changes.

schema.detail: No database schema or stored-data changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or fleet coordination changes.

compatibility.detail: The ci-script-tests and ci-genie-freshness entrypoints ignore global and system Git configuration so fixture repositories do not inherit host hooks, identity or signing settings. Pool-cap policy tests measure apparent fixture sizes independently of filesystem compression and delayed allocation, receive hooks locate Bash through PATH, and the build-scope fixture explicitly controls ST_EVIDENCE_GOVERN. Production st-test behavior and its Git transport configuration are unchanged.

downtime.detail: Only offline checks and their fixtures change; no service interruption.

manual.detail: No operator steps or host Git configuration changes required.

recovery.detail: No persistent state changes or rollback restrictions.
